# Feature Grid

`features/feature-grid` &middot; section-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

Features in a grid of 1 to 4 columns with an optional heading and button. Two-, three- and four-feature layouts are variants.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `features` | features |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Three features across.
- **two-feature**: Two features across. Sets `columns: 2`.
- **four-feature**: Four features across. Sets `columns: 4`.
- **list**: One feature per row as icon + text. Sets `columns: 1`, `item: row`.
- **tinted**: Three features on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `3`, `1`, `2`, `4` | `3` |
| `item` | one of `card`, `row` | `"card"` |
| `cardVariant` | one of `default`, `left`, `round-icon` | `"default"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `1`, `2`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. mobileColumns is ignored. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts shows the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/feature-grid', {
  "heading": "Why you will love it",
  "intro": "Everything we make comes with a promise.",
  "features": [
    {
      "icon": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=Ship",
        "alt": "Shipping",
        "decorative": true
      },
      "title": "Free shipping",
      "description": "On every order over $75, tracked to your door."
    },
    {
      "icon": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=Return",
        "alt": "Returns",
        "decorative": true
      },
      "title": "60-day returns",
      "description": "Not right? Send it back, we cover the postage."
    },
    {
      "icon": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=Repair",
        "alt": "Repairs",
        "decorative": true
      },
      "title": "Repaired for life",
      "description": "We mend it free, for as long as you own it."
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "Read our promise",
    "href": "https://example.com/pages/promise"
  }
}) ]]
```
